description: PB-71 is the Sub-Divisional Regional Transport Office located in Chamkaur Sahib, Punjab. This office operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits for the Chamkaur Sahib sub-division within the Rupnagar district.
address: SDM Office, Chamkaur Sahib, District Rupnagar, Punjab
